scope: PAL4 startup registration and isolated offscreen D3D9 draws with the game bytecode, plus a separately identified game startup trace when present.

historical.scope: The earlier queue records end before the next boot. Missing events cannot locate the initiating failure.

capture.source_identity: Original pixel-shader bytecode followed by the packed SWVP, float-emulation and force-sampler option bytes reproduces the upstream DXVK MD5 identifier. All 17 match both historical lists.
capture.private_inputs: Only source hashes and validation metrics are published.

reproduction.inputs: One software DXVK key per line, in original program order. Give the client the private DXVK dump folder with <key>.sm3_dxbc files.
reproduction.render: Hidden 800x600 D3D9 device. Offscreen 48x48 A8R8G8B8 / D24S8 with a 32x32 quad, colored 2x2 point-sampled texture, XYZRHW vertices and constant registers. The fixed-function center pixel and outer clear border are checked. Each captured shader is drawn twice, full images must match within each renderer. The test finishes before presentation.
reproduction.comparison: All 1024 covered pixels are compared across renderers. Also report the 900 remaining after removing x=8 or 24 and y=8 or 24, where the interpolated test coordinates meet base wrap/point-sampling boundaries. These are diagnostics of this test geometry.

power_observation.scope: This transition was sampled before the new game shader tests. No game process was found in the two bench preflights. The exact failed clock operation and the relationship to prior resets are unknown.
power_observation.measurement_limit: The restored live Handheld policy reported zero current error. The service registry still contained the previous error value. The common failure latch can record either the initiating status or a failed clock recovery, without identifying the initiating operation.

interpretation: All 17 original shaders register and produce stable offscreen GPU readbacks in the original DXVK/NVK configuration. Game-specific geometry, resource loading, visible presentation, normal exit and the root cause of the game reset require separate evidence.

instrumented_dxvk.scope: An opt-in diagnostic rebuild at the pinned DXVK revision. The clean rebuild had seven differing PE sections versus the installed original. Renderer identity, signing, a normal exit and 17 original offscreen readback hashes are checked in its own control. Synchronous file writes alter timing.

game_startup_boundary.interpretation: The retained journal ends with the seventh texture creation on the application thread and the seventeenth compiler job on a worker. The job ordinal does not identify a particular game shader. The gap to the next Windows boot includes unobserved time and boot initialization. These overlapping calls cannot by themselves identify the initiating fault.
